scoring_justification: Effective length Leff is derived from full multiscale FEM analysis; recomputing from raw artifacts is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. Scoring via structural ordering (length monotonicity, covalent > vdW, SWCNT > DWCNT) plus result comparison against paper-reported values with 10% relative tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold effective lengths for the six configurations from paper Fig. 15
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitised from the bar chart in Figure 15 of the source paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual digitisation; verified against trends described in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values originate from published research results and are used only to set tolerance thresholds for comparison.

outputs.description: Effective lengths for DWCNTs (vdW and covalent) at four lengths and for a (8,8) SWCNT, quantifying load transfer efficiency.

output_contract.notes: The effective lengths are compared against hidden reference values digitized from the paper with a tolerance of ±10%, and an additional structural ordering condition (monotonic increase with length, covalent > vdW) is enforced by the checker.

steps.description: Evaluate effective length values against hidden gold and enforce structural ordering.
